概念モデルが安定してから、物理ソースへバインドする。: Bind to physical sources only after the conceptual model has stabilized.
簡潔なセマンティック補足（説明・同義語・集計ガード）を加える。: Add concise semantic supplements (description, synonyms, aggregation guards).
キー・FK 解決・件数・経路・曖昧性・境界を検証する。: Validate keys, FK resolution, record counts, traversal paths, ambiguity, and boundaries.
ステップ 10 が「バインドは最後」である点が重要です。物理列に合わせて概念を決: Step 10 — "bind last" — is critical. If you decide concepts to match physical columns, swapping the source breaks the business vocabulary instantly.
3.2 粒度・業務識別子・代理キー: 3.2 Grain, business identifier, and surrogate key
設計の最初に決めるのは粒度です。粒度を 1 文で書けない概念は、まだ設計が決まっ: The first thing to decide in design is the grain. A concept whose grain cannot be written in one sentence has not yet been designed. Next, separate the stable identifier that the business side uses in conversation, the surrogate key assigned for implementation convenience, and the display name.
1 行 / 1 インスタンスが表す業務上の単位。: The business unit represented by one row / one instance.
「1 寄付申込」「1 自治体」「1 自治体 × 1 カテゴリ」「1 分バケットの: "1 donation application", "1 municipality", "1 municipality × 1 category", "1-minute bucket observation"
粒度を書けない概念は、まだ設計が決まっていない。: A concept whose grain cannot be written is not yet finalized in design.
業務側が会話で使い、時間が経っても変わらない ID。: An ID that the business side uses in conversation and does not change over time.
Ontology の Entity type key には業務識別子を使う。: Use the business identifier as the Ontology Entity type key.
実装都合で採番された内部キー。業務会話には現れない。: An internal key assigned for implementation convenience. It does not appear in business conversation.
Entity type key にはしない。必要なら Property として保: Do not use as the Entity type key. Retain as a Property if needed.
人間が読むためのラベル。一意とは限らない。: A label for human reading. Not necessarily unique.
キーにしない。曖昧な場合は ID を併記させる。: Do not use as a key. If ambiguous, display alongside the ID.
RDB のテーブルは、そのままでは Ontology の構成要素になりません。次: RDB tables do not become Ontology components as-is. The following table shows the mapping of source structures to Ontology patterns.
ソース構造から Ontology パターンへの対応: Mapping from source structure to Ontology pattern
業務側が名前と ID で会話でき、それ自体が主語になる。: The business side can refer to it by name and ID in conversation, and it itself becomes the subject.
同一性・金額・時刻・状態を持つトランザクションファクト: Transaction fact with identity, amount, timestamp, and status
1 行が業務イベントとして参照・追跡され、他概念の交差点になる。: One row is referenced and tracked as a business event and becomes the intersection of other concepts.
Relationship のコンテキスト表（Entity にしない）: Relationship context table (do not make it an Entity)
行そのものに業務的な名前・属性・ライフサイクルがない。: The row itself has no business name, attributes, or lifecycle.
独立した属性やライフサイクルを持つブリッジ: Bridge with independent attributes or lifecycle
契約日・状態・金額など、関係そのものに問い合わせたい属性がある。: There are attributes on the relationship itself — such as contract date, status, or amount — that need to be queried.
本データセットには該当なし（判断基準として提示）: Not applicable in this dataset (presented as a decision criterion)
1 エンティティにつき 1 値の属性: Attribute with one value per entity
単独では主語にならず、常に親エンティティの説明に使われる。: Cannot stand alone as a subject; always used to describe a parent entity.
「A×B の集計値」を安定した ID で参照させ、二重集計を構造的に防ぐ。: Allow the "aggregated value of A × B" to be referenced by a stable ID, structurally preventing double-counting.
既存エンティティに対する時刻付き観測: Time-stamped observation of an existing entity
観測はエンティティを増やさない。既存エンティティの時間軸の測定値になる。: Observations do not add entities. They become time-axis measurements of existing entities.
イベント自体が業務上の主語になる: The event itself becomes the business subject
「そのイベント」を ID で参照し、状態遷移や関係を辿る要求がある。: There is a requirement to reference "that event" by ID and trace state transitions or relationships.
本ワークショップでは採用しない（観測は集約ビューのみ）: Not adopted in this workshop (observations use aggregate views only)
業務語彙ではなく実装都合の情報。意味層に持ち込むと質問空間が汚れる。: This is implementation-convenience information, not business vocabulary. Bringing it into the semantic layer pollutes the question space.
3.4 判定木（ソース構造から Ontology 構成要素へ）: 3.4 Decision tree (from source structure to Ontology construct)
迷ったときは次の判定木を上から順にたどります。判定は 7 段あり、1 つのソース: When in doubt, follow the decision tree below from top to bottom. There are 7 levels; traverse it once per source structure and adopt the first conclusion that applies.
判定木の 7 段と、それぞれの結論: The 7 levels of the decision tree and their respective conclusions
監査・制御・技術メタデータ専用か: Exclusively audit, control, or technical metadata?
除外（Ontology に持ち込まない）: Exclude (do not bring into the Ontology)
Property（既存 Entity Type の属性）: Property (attribute of an existing Entity Type)
2 つの外部キーだけの純粋な中間表か: A pure junction table with only two foreign keys?
独自の属性・ライフサイクルを持つ中間表か: An intermediate table with its own attributes or lifecycle?
安定した識別子・金額・時刻・状態を持つ取引か: Is it a transaction with a stable identifier, amount, timestamp, and status?
既存エンティティへの時刻付き観測か: Is it a time-stamped observation of an existing entity?
事象自体を業務対象として問い合わせるならイベントエンティティ、そうでなければ t: If the event itself is queried as a business subject, use an Event Entity; otherwise, use time-series binding
いずれにも当てはまらず、独立した業務識別子を持つ: Matches none of the above, but has an independent business identifier
判定 4 を飛ばさないでください。2 つの外部キーだけに見える中間表でも、登録日: Do not skip Decision 4. Even if a junction table appears to have only two foreign keys, if it has its own attributes such as registration date, status, or contract period, or its own lifecycle, it is an Associative Entity, not a Relationship contextualization. The ot_supplier_gift in this workshop has no own attributes, so it stops at Decision 3.
判定 3 と判定 4 の分かれ目: The fork between Decision 3 and Decision 4
1 つのソース構造を 7 段の判定で振り分ける判定木。結論は除外、Propert: Decision tree that routes one source structure through 7 levels of decisions. The conclusion is one of: exclusion, Property, Relationship contextualization, Associative Entity, metric / flow Entity, Transaction Entity, Event Entity (イベントエンティティ), time-series binding, or master / dimension.
判定木の図。候補となるソース構造を 1 つ取り上げ、7 段の判定を順に通す。判定: Diagram of the decision tree. One candidate source structure is taken and passed through 7 levels of decisions in order. Decision 1 asks whether it is exclusively for audit, control, or technical metadata; if so, it is excluded. Decision 2 asks whether it yields a single value per existing entity; if so, it is a Property. Decision 3 asks whether it is a pure junction table with only two foreign keys; if so, it is a Relationship contextualization. Decision 4 asks whether it is a junction table with its own attributes or lifecycle; if so, it is an Associative Entity. Decision 5 asks whether it is a pre-aggregation at a composite grain; if so, it is a metric / flow Entity. Decision 6 asks whether it is a transaction with a stable identifier, amount, timestamp, and status; if so, it is a Transaction Entity. Decision 7 asks whether it is a time-stamped observation of an existing entity; if the event itself is queried as a business subject it is an Event Entity, otherwise it is a time-series binding. Anything with an independent business identifier that matches none of the above is a master / dimension Entity Type. Decisions are shown as diamonds, conclusions as rounded boxes, exclusions as red dashed borders, aggregate-only entries as double borders, and time series and events in orange.
Relationship は、起点（Origin）と終点（Target）を選んだ: A Relationship becomes a business assertion the moment you choose its origin and target. "A municipality belongs to a prefecture" is Municipality → Prefecture, not the reverse. A question in the reverse direction (the list of municipalities belonging to a given prefecture) is answered by reverse traversal while keeping the declared direction.
向き：業務の主語と目的語をそのまま写す。実装の都合で反転させない。: Direction: reproduce the business subject and object as-is. Do not reverse for implementation convenience.
カーディナリティ：1 側と多側を業務ルールとして宣言する（例：1 自治体は必ず: Cardinality: declare the one side and the many side as a business rule (e.g., 1 municipality always belongs to exactly 1 prefecture).
否定的意味：その関係が証明しないことを明記する（例：カタログ登録は発送ではない）: Negative meaning: explicitly state what the relationship does not prove (e.g., catalog registration is not shipment).
集計ガード：どの経路で件数・金額を集計してよいかを宣言する。: Aggregation guard: declare which paths may be used to aggregate counts and amounts.
多対多：橋を通した金額集計は、明示的な配賦ルールがない限り禁止する。: Many-to-many: aggregating amounts through a bridge is prohibited unless there is an explicit allocation rule.
3.6 メトリック Entity にするかどうか: 3.6 Whether to make it a Metric Entity
集計値をどこに置くかの判断: Decision on where to place aggregated values
単一エンティティの集計値: Aggregated value of a single entity
親エンティティの Property にする: Make it a Property of the parent entity
MunicipalityStaticCount / MunicipalitySt: MunicipalityStaticCount / MunicipalityStaticTotalYen are Properties of Municipality.
2 つ以上のエンティティの交差による集計値: Aggregated value from the intersection of two or more entities
自治体 × カテゴリ、都道府県 × カテゴリ、居住地 × 受入先。: Municipality × category, prefecture × category, residence prefecture × recipient prefecture.
全国スコープと都道府県内スコープを別 Property に分け、足し算を禁止する: Separate the national scope and prefecture-level scope into distinct Properties and prohibit addition between them.
明細から毎回計算できる値: A value that can be calculated every time from line-item detail
原則として明細に任せる: As a rule, leave it to the line-item detail
ただし粒度の取り違えが起きやすい場合は、事前集計を独立させる。: However, when grain confusion is likely, isolate the pre-aggregation independently.
3.7 time-series バインディングにするか、イベント Entity: 3.7 Whether to use time-series binding or an Event Entity
時刻付き観測の扱いの判断: Decision on how to handle time-stamped observations
観測に独立した業務上の同一性がない: The observation has no independent business identity
観測はエンティティを増やさず、既存エンティティの測定値になる。: Observations do not add entities; they become measurements of existing entities.
観測を ID で参照し、他の概念と関係を結びたい: Need to reference observations by ID and form relationships with other concepts
イベント自体が主語になり、状態や関係を持つ。: The event itself becomes the subject and has state and relationships.
観測はダッシュボードと監視のためだけに使う: Observations are used only for dashboards and monitoring
基幹エンティティ層を汚さず、Ontology の質問空間を小さく保てる。: The core entity layer is not polluted, and the Ontology question space is kept small.
重複排除・履歴補正が業務要件にある: De-duplication or history correction is a business requirement
イベント Entity または別レイヤー: Event Entity or a separate layer
集約ビューだけでは重複排除を証明できない点に注意する。: Note that de-duplication cannot be proven with aggregate views alone.
本ワークショップは time-series バインディングを選びます。したがって: This workshop chooses time-series binding. Therefore, the aggregate views that the Data Agent references do not contain EventID, and it is not possible to "prove" the post-de-duplication count. This constraint is explicitly confirmed in Test 7 of Chapter 17.
テーブルをそのまま Entity にする: Making a table an Entity as-is
正規化・非正規化の都合がそのまま業務語彙になり、質問が実装に依存する。: Normalization and de-normalization decisions become business vocabulary as-is, causing questions to depend on the implementation.
業務上の主語だけを Entity にし、残りは Property か Relat: Make only business subjects into Entities; make the rest Properties or Relationship contexts.
外部キーをすべて Relationship にする: Making every foreign key a Relationship
意味のない経路が増え、エージェントが誤った多段経路を選ぶ。: Meaningless paths proliferate, and the agent selects incorrect multi-hop traversal paths.
業務的に意味のある FK 経路だけを Relationship にする。: Make only FK paths that are meaningful to the business into Relationships.
Relationship に向きの意味を与えない: Giving no directional meaning to a Relationship
「登録している」と「受け取った」が同じ経路として扱われ、集計が壊れる。: "Registered" and "received" are treated as the same path, breaking aggregation.
方向・カーディナリティ・否定的意味（何を証明しないか）を宣言する。: Declare direction, cardinality, and negative meaning (what it does not prove).
多対多の橋を通して金額を集計する: Aggregating amounts through a many-to-many bridge
1 つの Gift に複数 Supplier がいると金額が重複計上される。: If one Gift has multiple Suppliers, the amount is double-counted.
集計ガードを宣言し、配賦ルールがない限り橋越しの金額集計を禁止する。: Declare an aggregation guard and prohibit cross-bridge amount aggregation unless there is an allocation rule.
複合粒度の集計を明細から毎回計算させる: Recalculating composite-grain aggregations from detail every time
粒度の取り違えと二重集計が起きやすく、回答が不安定になる。: Grain confusion and double-counting are likely, making answers unstable.
複合粒度だけをメトリック Entity として独立させ、再集計を禁止する。: Isolate only composite-grain aggregations as Metric Entities and prohibit re-aggregation.
観測イベントを明細エンティティとして追加する: Adding observation events as detail entities
静的スナップショットと観測が合算され、件数が意味を失う。: Static snapshots and observations are summed together, causing counts to lose their meaning.
観測は time-series バインディングにとどめ、粒度を明示的に分離する。: Keep observations as time-series bindings and explicitly separate the grain.
表示名をキーとして使う: Using a display name as a key
同名の自治体・返礼品が存在すると、部分一致で誤ったインスタンスに到達する。: If municipalities or return gifts with the same name exist, partial matching reaches the wrong instance.
安定 ID をキーにし、表示名は表示専用 Property として分離する。: Use a stable ID as the key and separate the display name as a display-only Property.
